group.label: Events to Send
group.comment: Which order events Montu receives. The module only reports facts; Montu decides whether an order is paid or valid.

field.label: Send Order Placed (order.placed)
field.comment: Send an event when a qualifying order is created (see Order Filters). Turning this off stops all new orders from being tracked.

field.label: Send Order Updated (order.updated)
field.comment: Send an event when the state, status or paid / refunded / canceled totals of an already reported order change.

field.label: Send Credit Memo Created (creditmemo.created)
field.comment: Send an event, once per credit memo, when a refund is created for an already reported order.
